ValidationRule.description: This validation prevents a case from being closed if it has open child cases
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ISPICKVAL(Status, "Closed") && Number_of_Open_Child_Cases__c <>0 && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'Service_Request' && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'Issue' && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'Enquiry' && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'Complaint' && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'Internal_Case' && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'Customer_Profile_Update' && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'Credit_Card_Services' && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'db_AccountHold' && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'Prizeout' && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'Walkin_Customers' && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'Customer_Periodic_Review' && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'Compliance_Query' && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'Deceased_Customer' && RecordType_DeveloperName__c <> 'Loan_Application'
ValidationRule.errorMessage: A case cannot be closed if it has a child case open!
